# Method GetClasses

#### GetClasses(DocumentId)

Gets the first level classes entities that are in the classes folder of a classification document.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 10, 0, 0)]
List<ElementId> GetClasses(DocumentId inDocumentId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the classification document to analyze.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  List<ElementId> |  Classes entities found.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.10.
